gist.summary: Pinned the API docs’ Scalar CDN script to 1.73.1 after 1.74.0 changed sidebar markup, collapsing section headers and misplacing navigation icons. Updated the CSS to hide the “Powered by Scalar” link when its URL includes UTM parameters and to hide the “Generate MCP” button in its new `.scalar-mcp-layer` div.
